stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 rack-scale architecture — the cabinet designed to house 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, packing 144 GPUs per unit — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, because the specialized multi-layer PCB midplane that connects the system's modules remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint. The design had been slated to debut with Vera Rubin Ultra in 2027. Nvidia rejected the report (see separate item).
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.
The setback stems from difficulties manufacturing a key circuit board at the heart of the system, SemiAnalysis said in a post on Monday.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
